Name: More Building Options - Pack 1
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34977/34977-1750333313-1231291753.png[/img][/center]
Adds the following new buildings to Robin's building menu:

[list]
[*]Hay Bale
[/list]     Tier 1 hay storage. Holds 24 hay.
     Materials: None.
     Cost: 20g.
     Unlock: From start.


[list]
[*]Hay Shed
[/list]     Tier 2 hay storage. Holds 80 hay.
     Materials: 30 Wood, 10 Stone.
     Cost: 50g.
     Unlock: From start.


[list]
[*]Hay Shelter
[/list]     Tier 4 hay storage. Holds 720 hay.
     Materials: 400 Wood, 175 Stone, 5 Iron Bar.
     Cost: 5,000g.
     Unlock: 8 Hearts w/Marnie.


[list]
[*]Basic Campsite
[/list]     A home away from home. Comes with a bed and a permanent campfire for cooking.
     Materials: 5 Cloth, 125 Fiber, 50 Wood.
     Cost: 5,000g.
     Unlock: From start.


[list]
[*]Deluxe Campsite
[/list]     An upgraded campsite with a larger tent. Retains campfire.
     Materials: 25 Cloth, 50 Hardwood.
     Cost: 12,000g.
     Unlock: From start.


[list]
[*]Modern Campsite
[/list]     Upgrades the tent to a trailer, moves the campfire inside as a full-fledged kitchen.
     Materials: 30 Iron Bar, 15 Refined Quartz, 10 Battery Pack.
     Cost: 50,000g.
     Unlock: 8 Hearts w/Pam & her house upgraded.


[list]
[*]Additional Mailbox
[/list]     An extra mailbox to check your mail from elsewhere on the farm.
     Materials: None.
     Cost: 500g.
     Unlock: From start.


[list]
[*]Industrial Furnace
[/list]     A giant furnace which functions like a mill, but for smelting. Does not require coal.
     Materials: 50 Iron Bar, 5 Iridium Bar, 750 Stone.
     Cost: 65,000g.
     Unlock: 8 Hearts w/Clint.


In addition, adds one new bed (bundled with the [b]Basic Campsite[/b]:

[list]
[*]Wild Single Bed
[/list]     A single variant of the base-game's Wild Double Bed.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34977/34977-1750333319-941866730.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ (Optional)
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34977/34977-1750333324-30187698.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]If installing manually, delete the previous version and extract [b][CP] More Building Options Pack 1[/b] to your mods folder.
[*]If using Mod Organiser, load the .zip file and install as usual.
[*]If using a different mod manager... do whatever it is you usually do!
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34977/34977-1750333334-126381441.png[/img][/center]
[b]Buildings Enabled
[/b][list]
[*][i]Allows each building (except the Campsites, which are managed collectively) to be enabled or disabled.[/i]
[/list]
[b]Remove Unlock Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][i]Allows the unlock requirements for the Hay Shelter, Industrial Furnace, and Modern Campsite to be suppressed.[/i]
[/list][i]
[/i][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34977/34977-1750333340-2062583950.png[/img][/center]
No compatibility issues noted, but for transparency, the fridge in the Modern Campsite is a Mini-Fridge because I couldn't for the life of me work out how the normal fridge functions. You still need to pick it up and re-place it before it will function, but them's the breaks. Compatibility between [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Sword & Sorcery[/url] ores and the Industrial Furnace added in v2.3.0. As of Jan 2026, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/24394309]zombifier[/url] has added support for MBO to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26443]Chicken Feed[/url].

Downloads.Description: The first of three packs adding new constructible buildings to the game. This pack contains: Three additional tiers of hay storage, a campsite with two upgrades, an additional mailbox, and an industrial furnace.
